name: Chiemi
source:
There are three different scenarios. You end up on a different plane depending on which scenario you choose. You'll conduct an interview with the director in the beginning and how you answer her questions determines which path you take.

[Edited from [url=http://www.densetsu.com/display.php?id=451&style=alphabetical]HnN review[/url]]
translation:
游戏共有三条不同剧情线。玩家选择的剧情不同，最终搭乘的飞机也会不同。故事开始时，玩家将接受主任面试；对她的问题作出怎样的回答，将决定接下来进入哪条路线。

[根据[url=http://www.densetsu.com/display.php?id=451&style=alphabetical]HnN Review[/url]编辑]
